items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: Developed by Google Labs, stitch-skills is an agent skills library designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library supports open standards that can be used with various coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editing tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: ggml-org/ggml
items.summary: ggml-org/ggml is a tensor library developed in C++ for machine learning models. The software facilitates the execution of AI models by providing simple and descriptive examples for operations such as basic matrix multiplication.

snapshot.description: Tensor library for machine learning. For a minimal, fully commented example (matrix multiplication), see examples/simple.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter offers a skill package running on Claude Code for debugging and external red-team efforts. Developed in Python, this tool provides comprehensive content including report patterns covering 24 basic vulnerability classes and infrastructure attack matrices.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
items.summary: SkillEvaluator, developed by NVIDIA, is a multi-layered framework that evaluates the capabilities of AI agents through methods such as quality control, semantic conflict detection, and synthetic data generation. This tool offers live evaluation processes to measure the impact on agent behaviors.

snapshot.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
items.summary: An outage in the Microsoft 365 system led to an inability to control chlorine levels in a pool at the Phantasialand amusement park. Due to the technical glitch, 15 hotel guests were injured by chlorine gas poisoning.

snapshot.description: Wegen der Outlook-Störung am Freitag bekam das Phantasialand nicht mit, dass zu viel Chlor im Pool war. 15 Gäste wurden verletzt.

items.title: The MacBook Pro's OLED PWM problem
items.summary: The pulse-width modulation method used by OLED screens in MacBook Pro models to control brightness reduces screen comfort for some users. Although the image quality is high, this technology creates usage difficulties for individuals sensitive to screen flickering.

snapshot.description: Apple has made a spectacular display. But spectacular isn’t the same as comfortable, and the people discovering that distinction deserve to be heard.

items.title: Claude Code and Codex reverse engineered my 1994 Jeep's ECU over a $3 Arduino [video]
items.summary: Using Claude Code and Codex models, the engine control unit (ECU) of a 1994 Jeep was reverse-engineered with the help of a $3 Arduino development board. This study demonstrates the potential of AI tools in the process of analyzing automotive hardware data protocols.

items.title: Qwen4-Max
items.summary: Qwen4-Max offers comprehensive functions such as chatbot, image and video understanding, visual generation, document processing, web search, tool use, and AI content generation (artifacts). Developed by Alibaba, this large language model aims to respond to various user needs with its multimodal capabilities.

snapshot.description: Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.

items.title: Protomaps: Self-hosting map tiles has gotten cheap and easy
items.summary: Protomaps makes hosting map tiles on your own server more accessible and economical. The PMTiles format used in this process works via HTTP Range requests and can be distributed to storage areas as a single file.

snapshot.description: PMTiles is a tile format which works via HTTP Range requests and can be deployed as a single file to a storage bucket.

items.title: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image is a model with text-to-image generation capabilities. It is recommended to use the qwen3.59bw4a8gptq text generation tool during prompt refinement processes.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. For prompt enhancement, we recommend to use the model qwen3.59bw4a8gptq with the Generate Text node.

items.title: eDIAR: Training-Free Open-Speaker Streaming Diarization for Long Meetings and Large Archives via e-means
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, eDIAR is a training-free speaker diarization method that eliminates the need to pre-determine the number of speakers in long meetings. The system can operate online without fixed output slot limitations by clustering speaker embeddings with the e-means algorithm.

snapshot.description: Meetings last up to an hour, and nobody knows in advance how many people will speak. Neural diarizers with a fixed number of output slots, such as Streaming Sortformer and Nemotron-3, are accurate and run online, but they cannot name more speakers than they have slots. We remove this limit without retraining. items.title: Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: Disen-Forcing aims to decouple motion from semantic anchoring to stabilize long-term video generation in autoregressive video diffusion models. The method seeks to reduce quality loss in video generation by examining the impact of existing approaches inspired by attention sinks in large language models (LLMs) on long-term consistency.

snapshot.description: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. items.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
items.summary: JVT (Just Video Transformer), shared by Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model that facilitates the processing of high-dimensional raw video data directly in pixel space. This architecture aims to simplify video diffusion processes without the need for complex auxiliary components or pre-trained encoders.

snapshot.description: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. items.title: Aligning AI Teams
items.summary: The 'Aligning AI Teams' paper, shared by Hugging Face, examines the failures in transferring alignment training of large language models (LLMs) from individual agents to multi-agent systems. The research analyzes the causes of this misalignment through software engineering and consulting tasks, and discusses intervention methods to maintain the safety of AI teams.

snapshot.description: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. We focus on two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks. We present four findings: (1) The single-vs-team safety gap does not show a clear trend with more capable models.

items.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.summary: Gamer is a general-purpose AI agent framework designed to perform long-term tasks in complex interactive environments. Its architecture, which combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning capabilities, supports interaction with both 2D graphical interfaces and 3D simulation worlds.

snapshot.description: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
Test studies that mimic the methods of malicious attackers to find security vulnerabilities in a system.
Functional capabilities acquired by artificial intelligence agents to perform operations in a specific area.
A ready-made structure and set of rules that form the basic framework and facilitate tasks in the software development process.
A method used to control values such as screen brightness by changing the duration of digital signals.
The electronic control unit that manages the operation of the engine and other systems in vehicles.
The process of disassembling a ready-made product to understand how it works, examining its structure, and deciphering its operating principle.
